steps.fact: CRM record HEL-441 corresponds to the counterparty name Helion Robotics Ltd.
Commercial notes state that Helion Robotics Ltd is the operating name used in CRM and that invoices use Helion Robotics Limited, and that these are the same legal entity.
Billing records bill the counterparty as Helion Robotics Limited.
crm:HEL-441 and billing:Helion Robotics Limited therefore denote the same legal counterparty.

support_claim: HEL-441 maps to Helion Robotics Ltd in CRM, commercial notes explicitly identify Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited as the same legal entity, and billing invoices use Helion Robotics Limited.
